article_context: Body image for the "Caves of the Island" attraction: it illustrates the hands-on spelunking adventure of moving through narrow, hidden rock passages as part of a scientific expedition.
image_reading: A smiling helmeted woman in protective clothing crawls upward through a tight, rounded rock tunnel, looking toward the opening above.
Her raised hand braces against the low cave ceiling while the other supports her on the rock; the warm tunnel contrasts with the dark passage behind her.

models.positive_prompt: The explorer steadily crawls forward through the narrow cave passage, shifting her weight upward while keeping one hand braced on the rock. Fixed camera. By the final moment she is visibly closer to the opening, securely supported and still smiling.
models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, the woman makes one controlled forward crawl through the constricted tunnel: her supporting arm and torso advance gradually while her raised hand maintains contact with the rock. Keep the overhead view fixed on her progress. Near the end she settles a little higher and closer to the opening, holding her confident smile.

models.positive_prompt: She carefully advances upward through the tight cave tunnel, transferring her weight forward beneath the rock ceiling. Keep the camera fixed on the explorer. End with her securely positioned closer to the opening, still smiling with determined curiosity.
models.scene_plan: Use the full five seconds for a smooth, moderate crawl forward. The explorer shifts her body upward through the passage in one continuous effort, retaining visible contact with the cave wall for balance. A fixed overhead perspective keeps her helmet and face clear; her forward position is visibly higher by the final frames.

models.positive_prompt: Fixed overhead camera on the woman as she steadily crawls upward through the narrow cave passage, shifting forward under the low rock ceiling. She ends closer to the opening, firmly braced and smiling with focused curiosity.
models.scene_plan: In four seconds, show a compact but natural continuation of her crawl: she moves forward and upward at an even pace, using the surrounding rock for support. Keep the camera still so the narrow passage and her gradual approach remain clear. In the last moment she is visibly closer to the opening, stable and upbeat.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: A visitor experiences the attraction as an active, immersive cave expedition rather than an ordinary walk through the park.
structured_intent.primary_action: The explorer steadily crawls forward through the narrow cave passage.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: She remains a confident, curious participant in the cave expedition.
structured_intent.terminal_state: She is visibly closer to the tunnel opening, securely braced on the rock and still smiling.
